description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח לרכב
description.summary: This table outlines the terms of a vehicle insurance policy from Harel Insurance Company Ltd. It details the insured event, covered risks, and how compensation is calculated.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תנאי פוליסת ביטוח רכב של הראל חברת ביטוח בע״מ. הפוליסה היא חוזה בין המבטח למבוטח, ומפרטת את האירוע הביטוחי, הסיכונים המכוסים ואופן חישוב הפיצוי. ניתן לעיין בפרטי הפוליסה, כולל דמי הביטוח, תקופת הביטוח, ההשתתפות העצמית, מחירון וגבולות האחריות, במפרט המצורף. הפוליסה מכסה אובדן או נזק לרכב המפורט במפרט, כולל אביזרים וחלקים בסיסיים, כתוצאה מסיכונים מפורטים. הראל חברת ביטוח בע״מ, מבוטח, רכב, אובדן או נזק, אירוע ביטוחי.

22.5 The new insurance certificate delivered by the insurer to a policy owner as stated in paragraph 22.2, shall specify - in the title of the insurance certificate, in the line under "Motor Vehicle Insurance Ordinance (New Version), 5730 - 1970 (hereinafter the "Insurance Ordinance") -as follows: "A vehicle which is laid-up shall not be used for driving or parking"; the said aforementioned words will appear in a font three times larger than the rest of the certificate and will be emphasized by means of a double frame or in another way as approved by the Commissioner for a particular insurer. The name of the authorized driver of the vehicle and his ID number will not appear therein.
Preamble
PART 2 -INSURANCE POLICY FOR PRIVATE AND COMMERCIAL VEHICLES
UP TO 3.5 TONS PROPERTY DAMAGES AND THIRD PARTY DAMAGES
This Policy is a contract between
Harel Insurance Company Ltd. (hereinafter 'the Insurer ')
and
The Insured whose name is noted in the specification (hereinafter 'the Insured ')
Whereby the Insurer agrees, in consideration of the insurance fees, to indemnify the Insured during the period of insurance in respect of loss or damage sustained by the insured vehicle due to the insured event, and for damage to third party property, all in accordance with the conditions of this Policy (hereinafter 'the scope of cover').
The insurance fees, the period of insurance, the deductible, the name of the pricelist and the limits of liability according to Chapter B are noted in the specification which constitutes an integral part of this Policy.
1. The Insured Event
The insured event is loss or damage sustained by the vehicle noted in the specification, including the accessories and assemblies in the basic package in regard to the vehicle model (without which the vehicle cannot be purchased) as appearing in the importer's specification, the vehicle air conditioner, the advanced safety systems fitted in the vehicle, the protective means fitted in the vehicle upon the Insurer 's demand, the accessories existing in the vehicle by virtue of the law or the accessories affixed to the vehicle as noted in the specification (hereinafter 'the vehicle'), as a result of one of the risks detailed below:
